THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

Four (4) allotments of land in total extent of about 0.0373 Hectareshown as Lots 'A' – 'D' in Advance Tracing No. MR/WLP/2014/147of 28.08.2014 prepared by the Surveyor - General Situated in theVillage of Beraleliya Minor Division of Weligam Korale, DivisionalSecretary's Division of Welipitiya in Matara District, SouthernProvince:

01. Lot "A" – Medakella Kumbura – Extent: 0.0139 HectareNorth: Road (R.D.A.), Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Lot C; East:Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Lot C; South: Lot D, Southern ExpressWay and Lot B; West: Lot B and Road (R.D.A.).
02. Lot "B" – Medakella Kumbura – Extent: 0.0133 HectareNorth: Road (R.D.A.) and Lot A; East: Lot A; South: Lot A and
Southern Express Way; West: Southern Express Way and Road(R.D.A).
03. Lot "C" – Medakella Kumbura – Extent: 0.0071 HectareNorth and East: Road (Predeshiya Sabha); South: Lots D and A;West: Lor A.
04. Lot "D" – Medakella Kumbura – Extent: 0.0030 HectareNorth: Lots A, C and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road(Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Southern Express Way; West: SouthernExpress Way and Lot A.
Janaka Bandara Thennakoon,Minister of Lands and Land Development.
